 ipv6 address <DA-ASSEGNARE-IPv6-in-2001:db8:c1a5::/64>/64

no ip http server

access-list 10 deny   any log

snmp-server host 192.0.2.43 version 3 priv monitor

 address ipv4 192.0.2.41 auth-port 1812 acct-port 1813

 key <DA-ASSEGNARE-SEGRETO-UNICO>

logging trap informational

ntp source Vlan999

ntp server 192.0.2.45

line con 0
 exec-timeout 5 0
 logging synchronous
line vty 0 4
 access-class 10 in
 exec-timeout 15 0
 transport input ssh

 access-class 10 in
